name: Install all Windows updates
desc: Security, quality and feature-pack updates offered by Windows Update. Drivers are left alone.

name: Install security updates only
desc: Only updates classified as Security or Critical. The safest choice for servers and older PCs.

name: Install specific updates (KB)
desc: Only the KB numbers you enter, for example KB5066835. Useful to roll one fix out everywhere.

name: Check for Windows updates
desc: Lists what Windows Update would install, without installing anything.

name: Show file extensions
desc: Shows .exe, .pdf and so on, so a file called invoice.pdf.exe cannot pretend to be a PDF. Recommended.

name: Show hidden files
desc: Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

name: Open File Explorer to This PC
desc: Starts at your drives instead of Home/Quick access.

name: Classic right-click menu
desc: Windows 11: shows the full context menu straight away, without "Show more options". Takes effect after sign-out.

name: Dark mode
desc: Dark theme for Windows and apps.

name: Taskbar icons on the left
desc: Windows 11: aligns the Start button and taskbar icons to the left, like Windows 10.

name: Turn off ads and suggestions
desc: No suggested apps in Start, no tips on the lock screen, no silently installed promoted apps. Recommended.

name: No web results in Start search
desc: Start menu search only looks at your PC, not Bing.

name: Minimal diagnostic data
desc: Sends Microsoft only the required diagnostic data. Needs administrator rights.

name: Turn off Copilot
desc: Hides Windows Copilot for all users.

name: High performance power plan
desc: Keeps the CPU ready instead of saving power. Good for desktops and workstations, not laptops on battery.

name: Turn off hibernation and Fast Startup
desc: Frees disk space and makes Shut down a real shutdown, which fixes many "restart fixes it" issues.

name: Allow long file paths
desc: Lets programs use paths longer than 260 characters. Useful for developers.

name: Allow Remote Desktop
desc: Lets you connect to this PC with Remote Desktop (Pro and Enterprise only), with Network Level Authentication on.

name: Create a restore point
desc: Takes a System Restore snapshot so you can roll back if something goes wrong. Put it first in a setup.

name: Windows Subsystem for Linux
desc: Run Linux tools and distributions on Windows. Needs a restart.

name: Hyper-V
desc: Microsoft's virtual machine platform (Pro and Enterprise). Needs a restart.

name: Windows Sandbox
desc: A throwaway desktop for opening untrusted files safely (Pro and Enterprise). Needs a restart.

name: .NET Framework 3.5
desc: Needed by many older programs and games.

name: OpenSSH server
desc: Lets you sign in to this PC over SSH. Starts automatically.

name: Remove SMB1 (insecure file sharing)
desc: Turns off the 30-year-old SMB1 protocol that ransomware like WannaCry used. Recommended unless you have a very old NAS.
